# bioexcel/biobb_dna/average_stiffness

## Summary

Calculate average stiffness constants for each base pair of a trajectory's series.

Calculate the average stiffness constants for each base pair of a trajectory's series. The input is a .ser file with the helical parameter values for each base/basepair. The output is a .csv file with the average stiffness constants for each base pair and a .jpg file with a plot of the average stiffness constants for each base pair.

Nextflow adapter of the [AverageStiffness](https://biobb-dna.readthedocs.io/en/latest/stiffness.html#module-stiffness.average_stiffness) building block of [biobb_dna](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_dna) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_DNA_AVERAGE_STIFFNESS } from 'bioexcel/biobb_dna/average_stiffness'

workflow {
    BIOBB_DNA_AVERAGE_STIFFNESS(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_ser_path` | yes | ser | Path to .ser file for helical parameter. File is expected to be a table, with the first column being an index and the rest the helical parameter values for each base/basepair |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_csv_path` | yes | csv | Path to .csv file where output is saved |
| `output_jpg_path` | yes | jpg | Path to .jpg file where output is saved |
| `versions_biobb_dna` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_dna', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of AverageStiffness properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_csv_path: 'csv']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_dna container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_DNA_AVERAGE_STIFFNESS' {
        ext.properties = [KT: 0.592186827]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `KT` | number | 0.592186827 | Value of Boltzmann temperature factor. |
| `sequence` | string | null | Nucleic acid sequence corresponding to the input .ser file. Length of sequence is expected to be the same as the total number of columns in the .ser file, minus the index column (even if later on a subset of columns is selected with the *usecols* option). |
| `helpar_name` | string | null | helical parameter name. |
| `seqpos` | array | null | list of sequence positions (columns indices starting by 0) to analyze. If not specified it will analyse the complete sequence. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
